instruction: Candid documentary photograph, eye-level full shot. Inside a spacious dojo featuring a textured brown wall and a green potted plant, the girl in the pink gi (R2) stands and leans forward, gripping the ankle of the woman in the black gi (R1). The woman in the black gi (R1) lies flat on her back on the black mat, raising her legs high to defend against the guard pass. Warm indoor lighting casts soft shadows across the training area, highlighting the dynamic movement of the two grapplers.
